g.text: Five cable GND contacts carry return current. Shell bonds through 0R; shell is not the only load return.

g.desc: Five cable GND contacts carry return current. Shell bonds through 0R; shell is not the only load return.

g.text: Approx. 0.51 A nominal is an adjustable study setting, not a qualified cable limit or a proven FPGA/ASIC power budget.

g.desc: Approx. 0.51 A nominal is an adjustable study setting, not a qualified cable limit or a proven FPGA/ASIC power budget.

g.text: Use a clean regulated 12 V source. Shared SMBJ15CA does not limit the XEM input to its 15 V operating maximum.

g.desc: Use a clean regulated 12 V source. Shared SMBJ15CA does not limit the XEM input to its 15 V operating maximum.

g.text: UVLO approx.10.2 V; OVLO approx.14.4 V. ITIMER/AUXOFF NC; FLT_N has no host-voltage pull-up.

g.desc: UVLO approx.10.2 V; OVLO approx.14.4 V. ITIMER/AUXOFF NC; FLT_N has no host-voltage pull-up.

g.text: A latch-off eFuse protects the single cable. Enable shunt is open by default; install only after the remote load is reviewed.

g.desc: A latch-off eFuse protects the single cable. Enable shunt is open by default; install only after the remote load is reviewed.
